system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Animal Handling and Survival, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Falconry Lore, Game Birds Lore, Hunting Grounds Lore.
system.description: You trained birds of prey and followed them across open country. You learned the patience required to earn an animal's trust and the care needed to bring a hunt to a safe end.
